description: This file defines the SystemCheckController class in the OrangeHRM system. It manages the display and rendering of the system check page within the Human Resource Management application, including configuration checks, theme variables, and rendering logic.

classes.name: SystemCheckController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling system check page logic in OrangeHRM, including initial configuration validation, preparing data for the view, and rendering the system check interface.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the controller, checking whether to display the system check screen based on configuration and setting response status accordingly.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component and template for rendering the system check page.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Populates context data for the view and renders the system check page.

methods.name: getDefaultThemeVariables
methods.description: Returns an array of theme variables with default color and style settings for use in the system check interface.
